verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS automation platform like Zapier, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting Zaps, workflows, task history, or account data in open formats. The published OpenAPI specs and API catalog describe Zapier's APIs, not a user data-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
